questions.slo: Explain and apply alkane names in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What is the molar mass of heptane (C=12, H=1)?
questions.e: Molar mass = 7×12 + 16×1 = 100 g/mol.
questions.slo: Explain and apply molar mass in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: Which is the main constituent of LPG along with propane?
questions.e: Commercial LPG commonly contains propane and butane.
questions.slo: Explain and apply alkane uses in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: When one mole of hexadecane burns completely, how many moles of carbon dioxide form?
questions.e: Each of the 16 carbon atoms forms one CO2, so 1 mol hexadecane yields 16 mol CO2.
questions.slo: Explain and apply combustion stoichiometry in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: After complete hydrogenation of a monoalkene with 11 carbon atoms, how many H atoms are in the product?
questions.e: Hydrogenation converts C11H22 to C11H24.
questions.slo: Explain and apply hydrogenation in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: Which shape best describes a methane molecule?
questions.e: Four electron pairs around methane carbon give a tetrahedral shape.
questions.slo: Explain and apply molecular geometry in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What is the molar mass of hexane (C=12, H=1)?
questions.e: Molar mass = 6×12 + 14×1 = 86 g/mol.
questions.slo: Explain and apply molar mass in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What replaces a hydrogen atom in alkane chlorination?
questions.e: Chlorine substitutes for hydrogen in a halogenation reaction.
questions.slo: Explain and apply halogenation in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What is the molar mass of nonane (C=12, H=1)?
questions.e: Molar mass = 9×12 + 20×1 = 128 g/mol.
questions.slo: Explain and apply molar mass in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: How many carbon-carbon single bonds occur in straight-chain heptadecane?
questions.e: A chain of 17 carbons has 17-1 = 16 carbon-carbon bonds.
questions.slo: Explain and apply alkane bonding in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: When one mole of dodecane burns completely, how many moles of carbon dioxide form?
questions.e: Each of the 12 carbon atoms forms one CO2, so 1 mol dodecane yields 12 mol CO2.
questions.slo: Explain and apply combustion stoichiometry in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: Which alkane has three carbon atoms?
questions.e: Propane is C3H8.
questions.slo: Explain and apply alkane names in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What is the molecular formula of a monochloroalkane obtained by replacing one H in C3H8?
questions.e: Substitution removes one H and adds one Cl, giving C3H7Cl.
questions.slo: Explain and apply halogenation in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: How many hydrogen atoms are in one molecule of decane?
questions.e: Decane is C10H22; hydrogen count is 2(10)+2=22.
questions.slo: Explain and apply alkane formula in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: When one mole of hexane burns completely, how many moles of carbon dioxide form?
questions.e: Each of the 6 carbon atoms forms one CO2, so 1 mol hexane yields 6 mol CO2.
questions.slo: Explain and apply combustion stoichiometry in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What type of hydrocarbon is ethyne?
questions.e: Ethyne has a carbon-carbon triple bond.
questions.slo: Explain and apply hydrocarbon classification in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: How many HCl molecules form when one molecule of C10H22 undergoes a single chlorination substitution?
questions.e: One hydrogen is replaced by chlorine, and the removed hydrogen combines with chlorine to give one HCl.
questions.slo: Explain and apply halogenation in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: When one mole of pentane burns completely, how many moles of carbon dioxide form?
questions.e: Each of the 5 carbon atoms forms one CO2, so 1 mol pentane yields 5 mol CO2.
questions.slo: Explain and apply combustion stoichiometry in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: When one mole of pentadecane burns completely, how many moles of water form?
questions.e: C15H32 contains 32 H atoms, giving 16 H2O per molecule.
questions.slo: Explain and apply combustion stoichiometry in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: How many carbon-carbon single bonds occur in straight-chain nonane?
questions.e: A chain of 9 carbons has 9-1 = 8 carbon-carbon bonds.
questions.slo: Explain and apply alkane bonding in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What is the molar mass of eicosane (C=12, H=1)?
questions.e: Molar mass = 20×12 + 42×1 = 282 g/mol.
questions.slo: Explain and apply molar mass in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: How many carbon-carbon single bonds occur in straight-chain hexadecane?
questions.e: A chain of 16 carbons has 16-1 = 15 carbon-carbon bonds.
questions.slo: Explain and apply alkane bonding in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What is the molecular formula of a monochloroalkane obtained by replacing one H in C14H30?
questions.e: Substitution removes one H and adds one Cl, giving C14H29Cl.
questions.slo: Explain and apply halogenation in hydrocarbons.

questions.q: How many carbon-hydrogen bonds are present in a molecule of ethane?
questions.e: The 6 hydrogen atoms in C2H6 each form one C-H bond.
questions.slo: Explain and apply alkane bonding in hydrocarbons.
